name: vton_bench
description: vton_bench is a visual benchmark for virtual try-on and clothing transfer tasks, measuring how well models synthesize person images wearing target garments and handle alignment, segmentation, and pose. It includes image-based conditional generation and related perceptual tasks used to evaluate virtual garment fit and realism.
reputation: A niche benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with modest adoption among researchers working on virtual try-on and image-conditioned synthesis.
